name: deploy-forward
description: Deploy Forward's marketplace of plugins for coding agents: Worklanes, the board in a client, and Convoy, several coding agents on one thread.

plugins.name: worklanes
plugins.description: Work a Deploy Forward board through the hosted board MCP (OAuth) plus five skills to operate the board, manage boards, set up Agent wake, connect an agent, and hand a card to a machine. Done stays a person's press.

plugins.name: convoy
plugins.description: Run several coding agents on one Convoy thread from any harness: start or reopen a thread, add agents, send and listen with receipts, wake, close, push and end. Each skill gives the command that works today.
